rights: All path data newly authored; CC0-1.0 spirit consistent with existing sonoma icons. FaceTime/Microsoft Teams names and call-control motifs remain Apple/Microsoft trademarks/designs; no such artwork license or endorsement is asserted, and no Apple Memoji/captured imagery is embedded.
fonts: UI requests installed -apple-system/BlinkMacSystemFont/Helvetica Neue stacks for Mac and Segoe UI for Windows, with local generic fallbacks. No proprietary font binaries are bundled by Calls assets; Linux fallback metrics are not certified native Mac/Windows font geometry.
researchLimits: Exact colors/radii and native binary geometry remain unverified. Golden Gate 27.0.1 binary and full Teams Free 23H2 package pixels were not observed. Modern Mac group capacity is conservatively local 32 total; initial Apple wording says 32 participants while selected living Sonoma guide says 32 other people. Base Mojave 10.14 is not backported to Group FaceTime: introduction 10.14.1 differs from security-restored supported 10.14.3 Supplemental minimum. Mac blocked callers can still receive outgoing/group calls; only incoming calls are suppressed. Windows blocking is an explicitly fictional shared communications equivalent. No camera, microphone, telephone, network or generated hardware audio is used; mute/camera/ringtone controls change actual authored local presentation only.
